verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents an asynchronous send endpoint but says nothing about idempotency keys, request deduplication, or duplicate-suppression semantics for retried sends. The only retry evidence covers MailerSend retrying its own outbound webhook deliveries, which is a different feature and does not prevent double-sending on a client-side retry.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can retry a failed send safely — idempotency keys or documented duplicate-suppression semantics guarantee a network timeout never double-sends a receipt
